---
title: "Standings"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
source("_data.R")
library(knitr)

standings %>%
  select(
    Participant        = user,
    Correct     = correct,
    Total       = total,
    `Win %`     = pct,
    `Base $`    = base_dollars,
    `Bonus $`   = bonus_dollars,
    `Missed $`  = missed_dollars,
    `Total $`   = total_dollars
  ) %>%
  kable()
```



```{r}
#| include: false

source("_data.R")

#Everyone's individual bonus picks winning percentage
results %>%
  filter(bonus %in% TRUE, !is.na(correct)) %>%
  group_by(user) %>%
  summarise(
    bonus_correct = sum(correct),
    bonus_total   = n(),
    bonus_pct     = round(100 * bonus_correct / bonus_total, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(bonus_pct))

#Combined bonus picks winning percentage
results %>%
  filter(bonus %in% TRUE, !is.na(correct)) %>%
  summarise(
    correct = sum(correct),
    total = n(),
    pct = round(100 * correct / total, 1)
  )
```
